run_update_analyze_test_checks: run update_analyze_test_checks.py to regenerate FileCheck patterns for LLVM opt analysis test files
update_test_file_checks: update FileCheck assertions in an LLVM IR test file by running the script with --opt-binary and test file arguments
update_single_function: update FileCheck checks for a single LLVM function in a test file using the --function argument
run_verbose_mode: run the script with --verbose flag to see detailed output of RUN line parsing and opt command extraction
parse_run_lines: parse RUN lines from LLVM test files to extract opt commands and FileCheck prefixes for analysis output generation
